register: Concise product copy in simplified Chinese: no pronoun where a sentence stands without one, 你 where one is needed, never 您. Full-width Chinese punctuation (，：；。？！（）) after a Chinese character, never ASCII , : ; ? ! ( ) or ...; ASCII punctuation only after Latin, a number or a {param} (Telegram: 正常); … is kept. One space between a Chinese character and a Latin word, a number, a {param} or any other ASCII run such as a path or a command (Gravit 正在运行, {n} 个任务, 打开 ~/.dsh 目录), none between two Chinese characters, none beside a full-width mark (已连接，Telegram). No full stop (。) on a value whose English ends in none: a label, a key. A name in keep is written as in keep, case-sensitive; a term's zh is written as in terms wherever its en is in an English value, unless the term's except names the key.
notes: Account → 账户 and Lunhui → 轮回 are terms, not names (operator, 2026-11-05); only Gravit is kept of the product names. A term's zh is never in keep.
token is kept in Latin (dsh Desktop writes it so) and is not a term: Telegram bot token, 令牌 is not used.
runSheet.writes carries ASCII quotes inside its title param: ZH must not add “” around {title} there.
sheet.guard.stop is the full stop a Guard line puts after words that end none ("." in EN): in ZH it is 。, and a ZH sentence that ends in 。 ！ or ？ needs none (sheet-view.js stopAfter reads the end).

A kept entry of more than one word or with punctuation (Noto Sans SC, npm run desk, xoxb-) stands as one string; the check removes kept strings, longest first, case-sensitive, before it reads the Latin that is left.

Not kept, so written in Chinese: Beijing, China, New York, URL, QR code, SEC, IPO, Pelosi, Beast (the Account's other mode), Gate 2, id, and the Lunhui contract words (REFERENCE, CLIMAX). No key name (Enter, Esc) and no English word (Delete, End, Home) is allowed in Latin: a ZH value writes them in Chinese.

Close, limit, Theme, Trade and sign have senses of their own (a position's close, a closing price, a limit order, a limit-up, a Lunhui theme, a tape of trades, a sign-out): the terms' except lists the keys that read otherwise, each with why; where one Chinese word is right it is named (`{ why, zh }`) and the held check requires it there.
